findings.note: His last five games were 19, 25, 26, 18 and 23 points, so three went over 21.5. The latest was 19 points in 29 minutes in a 130-93 blowout loss at Dallas on Nov 8, with fewer minutes than his usual 36-38. No injury flag is listed.
A CBS Sports piece from about four days ago rates Brooklyn (2-6) among the worst teams. It says Porter's scoring volume is down from last year's 24.2 ppg because Julius Randle is on the roster.
ESPN's preview of this game lists Porter's season average at 21.5 points on 45.2% shooting, the same as the betting line. No injury or lineup news for this game came up in the search.
